user.title: Datasat AP20/AP25
user.description: Connect to the audio processor over TCP. The default control port is 14500.

data.password: NetCmd or Setup password (leave empty if none)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the processor. Check the IP address, the port and whether the unit is switched on.

init.title: Datasat AP20/AP25 options
init.description: Formats and macros are read from the processor when its firmware supports listing them. Fill these in only if the lists below stay empty; names must match the unit exactly.

data.power_switch: External power switch entity (smart plug or relay)
data.power_on_macro: Macro to run after powering on
data.power_off_macro: Macro to run before powering off

data_description.power_switch: Only needed if the processor does not accept the POWER command. Point this at the switch that feeds it.

pulse.name: Pulse a GPIO output
pulse.description: Fires a 250 ms pulse on one of the GPIO outputs. Only works on units whose firmware accepts the PULSE command.

gpio.name: GPIO number
gpio.description: The GPIO output to pulse, 1 to 21.
